stopping_rule: Stop when 5-fold cross-validated macro accuracy on data/train no longer improves over the batch-1 best (0.690), or after at most 4 further training runs.

hyperparams.model: Pipeline: HOG(8,16) + color/hue grid + LBP histograms -> StandardScaler -> SVC(rbf), probability averaged with horizontal-flip TTA
hyperparams.augmentation: horizontal flip + 2px shifts on training set
